stages.prompt: *Kel scuffs his boot in the dirt.* "...I used to whittle, you know. Haven't picked it back up in years. Lost the last thing I ever carved. Silly to miss a piece of wood this much."
stages.journal_text: Give Kel a wooden horse carving.

paths.on_complete_message: *Kel Blushes* ...You're giving this to me? It's beautiful. Thank you. Really."

name: I got my ass kicked in Z'Goolok's Bog and all I got was my ass kicked as previously mentioned

stages.prompt:
*The Goo takes one look at you, still dripping and bruised, and goes very still.*

*Then they start rummaging under the counter, pulling out fishing tackle you didn't know they sold, quivering the whole time.*
stages.journal_text: The Goo has given you fishing tackle for something.

name: A Wet Flier
complete_message: *The Goo jiggles excitedly like a 70s Jello mold.  Or is it anxiously?  You can't really tell.*

stages.prompt: *The Goo vibrates as they notice your wet note.  You notice that they are, in fact, pretty wet.*
stages.journal_text: Show the Goo the bathhouse flier you found.

paths.on_complete_message: *The Goo gyrates, convulses and shimmies in a series of movements not unlike an interpretive dance.  Somehow, you understand this to mean that the bath house is in the sewers beneath the gnome market.*
